entry.title: New: dsh-plugins#dsh-appearance-gallery
entry.summary: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default. Exact install spec: github:wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-appearance-gallery. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
